title: 10 Best Ballota Nigra Preparations
intro: The best medicinal preparations of Ballota nigra are teas, decoctions, tinctures, mucillages, and oils, each offering unique therapeutic benefits. Teas made from the dried leaves and flowers are commonly used to soothe digestive issues and promote relaxation. Decoctions, which involve boiling the plant parts, are valued for their stronger potency and ability to extract more active compounds. Mucillages, derived from the plant's gelatinous mass, are used to ease inflammation and support respiratory health. Oils infused with Ballota nigra are applied topically to relieve muscle pain and enhance skin health.
